summary:
Shortly after being poisoned, Shinichi was found by the police and promptly escaped their custody to hurry back home. And it's a good thing too — if he hadn't run off when he did, who knows what could have happened to him?
Or: in which Shinichi doesn't outrun the police, and certainly doesn't make it home. Predictably, this makes everything worse.
